description: Electron-based Dynamic Island for Windows with media controls, system tools, notifications, clipboard, tasks, notes, and an app launcher.
notes: Verified with 7-Zip 26.05: the NSIS installer contains $PLUGINSDIR/app-64.7z. Scoop extracts the NSIS payload with #/dl.7z, then installer.script extracts app-64.7z with Scoop's Expand-7zipArchive helper. The nested archive contained 77 files including Quick Pill.exe at the payload root.

The official 5.5.1 update feed publishes an NSIS installer only; no official MSI asset was found. The MSI fallback was therefore unavailable and unnecessary after the nested NSIS payload extraction succeeded.

The built-in updater is enabled by default. Upstream checks for updates at startup and every two hours; when a newer version is available it can download the publisher's NSIS setup and silently execute it with /S. This can create or modify a separate per-user installation outside Scoop. The manifest does not disable or modify the application's updater.
Application settings and logs are stored under Electron's per-user userData directory.
